notes.title: Version 1.3.1.2 - Achievements, Accessibility, and more!
notes.content:
1.3.1.2

We've been working very hard since the last update! Version 1.3.1.2 is perhaps the biggest update we've released since the launch of the game way back in December 2019. It's also the first update to the Ubuntu build since 1.1.0.5 - about time we got that up to speed! Hard to believe how long it's been, and we're very grateful for those of you who've played our little game. It means more than you know.

First and foremost, a huge thanks to our speedrunning community, especially Butcherberries and Hapax. These incredibly skilled speedrunners have also proven to be incredibly skilled game testers - this update could never have fixed as many issues as it did were it not for their tireless help.

Among many, many other changes, the most noteworthy additions in this update are the in-game Achievements, and the new accessibility options. The changelog will go into more detail, but in short, you can take a look at this screenshot! It features the new achievements page on the main menu, as well as the new alternate font.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36266529/a01d4df22bf61a9f5f78f56028110b1cbafb0744.png

For more details, you can take a look at the full changelog below. Stay tuned, everyone - this won't be the last big update we release. Look forward to learning more soon. :)

PS - did you know we have a Discord server? Come hang out with fellow rabbit lovers!

Changelog

Additions:

 In-game achievements have been added! Use the Sync Steam Achievements button to unlock any achievements you've already unlocked on Steam. Each achievement unlocks a unique vignette on the main menu!
 An Intersex Pride palette has been added! This required a whole new system be designed to support the circle, but was well worth the effort. <3
 An alternate font option has been added, for anyone who may have difficulty reading the original pixel font.
 Players may now choose from three sprint options: Hold, Hold (Inverted), and Toggle. Hold is the default from previous versions of the game. Hold (Inverted) has Rabbit Girl sprinting by default, and walking while holding the Sprint button. Toggle switches between sprinting and walking when the Sprint button is pressed.


Enhancements:

 Menus can now be navigated using the Start button on controllers, similar to the Enter key on keyboard
 Major optimizations have been rolled out across the entire game, significantly improving performance
 Notably, the map screen now runs at a smooth 60fps, rather than dropping to single digit FPS values
 Certain aspects of the game have been reworked visually to increase contrast and increase readability
 Sprint behavior has been made much more consistent, and properly speeds up all forms of regular movement


Fixes:

 Countless layering issues have been fixed across the whole game
 Fixes various issues related to elevators and minecarts
 Fixes and re-enables the movement helper in a state in which it was previously disabled
 Various checkpoints have been tweaked for a smoother experience
 Fixes a very strange issue with Soundcatchers not triggering properly with rabbits in certain positions
 Fixes a handful of softlocks
 Fixes several minor visual issues
 Adds a trick for angel rabbits, who previously had no animation
 Several rabbits now bubble back to their starting position after falling offscreen
 A memory leak with special palettes has been fixed, significantly improving performance when wearing them
 Rabbit #100 now has a name. We're as shocked about this as you are

notes.title: 1.3.0.0 Update, Optimizations Galore
notes.content:
ANOTHER UPDATE AFTER QUITE A WHILE to fix some things and hooopefully not break the game!! The log isn't too big, so I'll keep it brief!

- Various softlocks have been fixed
- Certain small animation errors have been fixed
- Collected palettes no longer bounce
- Performance has been significantly improved
- The overall file size of the game has been significantly reduced

It's not a very glamorous update, but the game should run a lot better on low-end machines and takes up less than half the space! Wow!

There have been a lot of changes under the hood to update to Gamemaker 2.3 and keep everything in working order! We think we've squashed all the bugs that caused, but please don't hesitate to report any bugs!

Post about your bugs here in the comments/forums, or email us at info@nevermore.studio! You can also email us about anything else, though! <3

Thanks for playing! We've got lots more in store!

notes.title: 1.2.0.0 Update!! A new song, fixes, stuff!
notes.content:
Hey there!! It's been a whiiiile since the last update, but we've finally come around to clean things up!

Additions:
 - A long-requested feature of the palette swapping system has been implemented. Look forward to Rabbit Girl always wearing the fashionable palette of your choice, no matter what she may go through!
 - It's now much easier to keep track of which palettes have been collected on your global save file. The map screen will display a counter of palettes collected in the area you're in, even for areas which have no map. There has also been a full-game tracker added to the file select menu, breaking up the counts by area. Take a look at it once you've found all the palettes, and you might see something strange...
 - A brand new music track by our composer, Cory, has been added to the final area of the game. It's an absolute hit, and we hope you'll enjoy!

Enhancements:
 - The game can now be played in 16:9 windowed mode, so windowed players can also enjoy the borders
 - Rooms which have not been explored are now significantly more noticeable on the map
 - You can now press up and down to cycle through the palette selector more quickly
 - Menu confirm and cancel now match the keybinds for jump and call, respectively. If jump and call are set to the same key, confirm and cancel revert to their defaults
 - Carrots now get saved and loaded with your file (though it's slightly more difficult to carry them between areas, now!)

Fixes:
 - Pride palettes no longer get removed temporarily when global save data is deleted
 - Updates certain credits entries to better reflect individuals' names
 - Palette icon and count no longer overlap File 3 while copying or erasing a save file
 - Fixes game crash when attempting to copy a save file onto itself

Ingame Fixes:
 - [spoiler]Adjusts collision along the bottom of Cave to make for fewer blind falls when transitioning between rooms[/spoiler]
 - [spoiler]Adjusts collision in one room of the dark side of Cave to make a flying enemy more predictable[/spoiler]
 - [spoiler]Fixes a sound issue in which music would immediately fade out when loading a save file in Night Plateau[/spoiler]
 - [spoiler]Fixes a softlock in Night Plateau caused by becoming a bunny while under the effects of a yellow flower[/spoiler]
- [spoiler]Fixes a softlock in Night Plateau caused by an accidental glitched climb[/spoiler]

The new song will be on the bandcamp page soon! Please enjoy, and let us know it works please!

notes.title: Patch Notes for versions 1.1.0.5/6/ and 1.1.1.0!
notes.content:
Hello! Been a while, our bad--here's some changes, though! Some of these have already been rolled out, some are brand new!

- File Copying finally real.
- Bunnies that Fall Offscreen in a Few Rooms In The Cave will now float back up to safety-- will likely add these triggers to more levels later.
- Some rooms edited for a smoother gameplay experience. 
- Various tweaks to movement for more consistent gameplay
- Can once again assign multiple call shortcuts to the same keybind
- Dpad no longer moves the player when call shortcuts are enabled
- Some small bug fixes throughout the game
- A Palette List preview has been added to help find the palette you're looking for.
- Small Graphical Tweak--improved the look of the house at the beginning of the game.

Enjoy! More to come! Please report bugs to us, we check every discussion on the forum and read all our comments!

notes.title: 1.1.0.3 & 1.1.0.4 -- Hotfixes and Pride Palettes!
notes.content:
Happy pride month! Now that more people own this game due to its inclusion in the Bundle for Racial Justice and Equality (does NOT come with steam keys!), it's prime time to start updating this game. Here are some small fixes; More substantive changes will come!

1.1.03 Bugfixes
-Fixed a puzzle element in a transitional area being set incorrectly, causing a softlock.
-Fixed spawn point shifting (the process of shifting your spawnpoint by moving while spawning in).
-Added in Pride Palettes! You get them by... launching the game!
-Fixed a couple instances of sprints over small tiles getting stuck, though a more substantive rework of certain movement glitches is yet to come.

1.1.0.4
-Fixed a new bug created in the save room in the Plateue made by fixing some of the sprint hotfixes.

The Linux Build is now live! Enjoy!

notes.title: V.1.0.0.1 Hotfix!
notes.content:
Hotfixing, hotfixing, oh jeez, oh no! This isn't a big update, because it was rushed out the door to fix a nasty softlock, but to get into the habit of it...

----UPDATE NOTES----

--Bug Fixes--
-Fixed a pretty devastating checkpoint location in the final stretch of the game forcing a softlock, requiring a save reload... my bad!

--Level Design--
-Moved something around to make how to proceed more initially obvious; Might need to make a sign making it explicit later, depending.

------------

...And that's all she wrote! Hopefully the softlock didn't ruin your experience. Be sure to report any bugs so we can squash them ASAP!

-Polar, Nevermore Team
